title: Dig It
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about digging. Soil is a block that turns into a tunnel block when it is touched, so Kit can walk straight into a hill and out the other side, and soil under his feet gives way and he sinks. A rock does not dig, a gold fleck pays when it is dug, and a lane of spikes on the surface is passed by tunneling under it and climbing a ladder out. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.tagline: What happens when you touch the ground?
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has a hill in his way and a lane of spikes on the surface. Soil turns to a tunnel when it is touched, rock stays, and gold pays when it is dug. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Soil is only a block with a touch setting: when it is touched, it becomes a tunnel
Made to be copied and taken apart
